### 2.3 增长驱动因素（电话会原文）

> "Revenue from Productivity and Business Processes was $37.8 billion and grew 14%."  
> "M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. And on a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%."  
> "Building on our Copilot momentum from Q3, net paid seat adds more than doubled sequentially, with paid seats now over 30 million."  
> "M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."  
> "M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth."  
> "LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."

**关键要点**：该分部增长主要由 M365 Commercial cloud（Copilot 推动净付费席位增加超 2 倍、ARPU 提升）、M365 Commercial products（大型长期合同带来 in-period 确认）和 LinkedIn（营销解决方案）共同驱动。分部经营利润率较去年同期提升 0.5 pp（57.4% → 57.9%）。

### 3.3 增长驱动因素（电话会原文）

> "Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."  
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity."  
> "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."  
> "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."  
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."  
> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."

**关键要点**：Azure 43% 增速再次超越市场预期，核心驱动是需求持续超过供给、CPU/GPU 效率提升使新增产能被迅速货币化、GitHub Copilot 6 月切换到按用量定价模式后的消费加速（`transcript.txt` 第 40,000–42,000 字符 Amy Hood 答 Brent Thill 问）。该分部经营利润率维持 40.6%（电话会称 41%），与去年持平，体现强经营杠杆。

## 七、口径提示（读者注意事项）

1. **分部营收相加 = 公司合计营收**：微软分部采用"细分核算"（disaggregation），三个分部收入加总等于公司合并收入（已验证勾稽）。但 **成本、经营费用、经营利润同样可逐项加总**，无跨分部消除项。

2. **"经营利润率"分部间不可直接比较**：Productivity and Business Processes 57.9%、Intelligent Cloud 40.6%、More Personal Computing 21.4% 反映各分部业务结构和成本构成差异。IC 的高营业成本占比（43%）源于 Azure 基础设施折旧与算力成本，PP 的高利润率则受益于软件订阅模式。不能因为 PP 利润率高就断定其"更好"。

3. **同比基数影响**：FY25 Q4 各分部均含各自基数效应（如 Windows 10 EoS 利好、Pandemic 后 PC 高基数、Azure 加速期），本季 YoY 数字需结合基数理解。Amy Hood 在电话会上明确指出 "year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix"（`transcript.txt` 后段）。

4. **报告口径 vs. 恒定汇率**：本报告主用报告口径（GAAP），部分项目在 `metrics.txt` 和 `press_release.txt` 中同时给出恒定汇率增速（用于剔除汇率影响、评估"底层业务"表现）。

5. **Microsoft Cloud 跨分部归属**：Microsoft Cloud 收入 $59.3B（+27%）并非一个独立分部，而是跨分部汇总指标，主要由 Azure（IC）、M365 Cloud（PP）、LinkedIn、Dynamics 365 等构成。**不应将 Cloud 收入与分部收入直接对比或加总**。

6. **非 GAAP 调整项**：本季度 EPS 的 GAAP vs. non-GAAP 差异来自 OpenAI 投资影响（Q4 净收益 $480M，EPS $0.07）和若干 discrete items（Anthropic $3.2B 收益 + VRP 节约 − XBOX 减值/遣散），净 $0.27 EPS 利好。**分部财务数字本身不区分 GAAP/non-GAAP**（分部数据未做 OpenAI 调整）。

7. **"经营费用"的构成**：分部层面"Operating expenses"指 R&D + Sales & Marketing + G&A 的合计，不含 Cost of Revenue（后者单独列示）。跨分部比较 OpEx 增长率时需注意 IC 的 OpEx 主要为共享 R&D 投入（电话会多次提到"shared R&D investments"）。

8. **FY27 前瞻非本期数据**：本报告所有数字均为 FY26 Q4 实际值。电话会提供的 FY27/Q1 前瞻指引（收入区间、增长预期、CapEx 预期等）仅为前瞻，不应与本季实际数据混淆。

---

**报告完毕。** 每一项数字均给出具体出处（文件名 + 工作表/行号 + 段落位置），三个分部与全公司合计勾稽一致，可供投研复用。
